meta.title: Improve Your Akhirah
meta.description: A free Islamic companion: the Quran with translations and audio, Hadith, prayer times, Qibla, duas and daily tools, in Arabic, Urdu and English.

brand.name: Improve Your Akhirah

home.heroText: Read and listen to the Quran, study Hadith and keep track of your prayers: free, in Arabic, Urdu and English.
home.freeNote: Free for everyone. Content comes from trusted, openly published sources.

quran.title: Quran
quran.text: All 114 surahs with Urdu and English translations, word-by-word meaning, tafsir and recitation.

hadith.title: Hadith
hadith.text: Bukhari, Muslim and the other major collections in Arabic, Urdu and English, with gradings.

search.title: Search
search.text: Search the Quran and Hadith in Arabic, Urdu, English or Roman Urdu.

prayerTimes.title: Prayer times & Qibla
prayerTimes.text: Accurate prayer times for your location, the Qibla direction and the Hijri date.

duas.title: Duas & Azkar
duas.text: Morning and evening azkar and everyday duas, with their references.

tools.title: Daily tools
tools.text: Tasbeeh counter, 99 Names of Allah, Zakat calculator and Khatam tracker.
